messages:
maya: Quick thread — we need final copy for Hosted / Dedicated / Private landing heroes + one webinar CTA and simple inbound routing before the launch email tomorrow. Keep options short; wewant a performance-first and an economics-first variant for each mode.

devin: Two hero sketches each (desktop + mobile notes):
- Hosted (Perf): "Prototype fast. Low-latency inference with SDKs & streaming."
- Hosted (Econ): "Start pay-as-you-go inference. Reduce token costs with batching & cache."
- Dedicated (Perf): "Committed GPU pools for predictable p99s."
- Dedicated (Econ): "Reserved capacity to lower unit cost at scale."
- Private (Perf): "On-prem / VPC deployments for consistent latency & control."
- Private (Econ): "Bring your infra: compliance-ready, cost-managed deployments."

ash: Subheads: Hosted: "SDKs + streaming. Minutes to integrate." Dedicated: "SLA-backed throughput and burst options." Private: "VPC, KMS, and audit logs." Mobile: shorten CTAs to two words where possible.

li: Bullets under each hero (3 max). Hosted: SDKs, streaming responses, token-level analytics. Dedicated: reserved GPUs, autoscale policies, SLA commitments. Private: VPC/on-prem, KMS/HSM, audit & compliance exports. Keep bullets tight for mobile.

sam: Legal check: avoid exact latency numbers unless Ops confirms. Use "low-latency" or "sub-second p50" only if verified. Claim batching & KV cache as platform features is ok. Link to benchmark writeup for any cost claims.

nate: Webinar CTA copy options: "Register  Serving LLMs: cost, latency, rollouts" or shorter "Join: Serving LLMs". Routing plan (simple): webinar_reg -> tag:marketing:webinar -> nurture(3 emails); demo_request -> AE queue (assign:enterprise) -> immediate outreach; benchmark_dl -> product-eval -> auto trial token. I'll post webhook payload examples in #eng-infra.

devin: CTA placement suggestions: primary = webinar / see latency & pricing (Hosted). Secondary = start trial / request demo. Add UTM params: utm_campaign=tri_mode_launch&utm_medium=web.

maya: Proposed A/B plan: run Perf vs Econ 50/50 for 72 hours, then promote winner to 80/20 for one week. Growth will monitor CTR -> demo_request conversion.

ash: Visuals: perf-first hero gets abstract infra illustration, econ-first gets pricing graph mock (no numbers). Li, can you deliver mobile comps by EOD?

li: Yep — will export both hero variants and mobile crops by 5pm PT.

maya: Action items: devin finalize copy + mobile CTAs by 3pm; li export comps by 5pm; nate publish webhook payloads & tags by EOD; sam confirm legal phrasing and benchmark links by EOD. I'll assemble the launch brief and email growth. React with :white_check_mark: to approve.
